content:
Ivy (CS): Dropping a compact 'demo quickshot' runbook we tried today: 1) prefill top-4 queries, 2) enable 2-token streaming heartbeat, 3) tenant cache 60s + region fallback. Low friction for CS.

Marcus (SRE): Nice. Two ops notes: cap concurrent prefill jobs per-region to 6, and emit prefill.job.failures metric.

Ruth (Eng): Also add sanitized mode flag for PII-sensitive tenants. If sanitized=true we replace names/emails with placeholders.

Theo (Solutions): Sample prefill payload we used: 
```
POST /v1/prefill
{
  "tenant_id":"acct-7777",
  "queries":["start","invoice","reset","summary"],
  "parallel":2,
  "sanitized":false
}
```
Works well with parallel=2.

Ivy (CS): Pilot: demos with prefill success rate up from ~70% -> 88% (n=18). Heartbeat reduces perceived wait.

Jordan (Customer): Confirmed. Heads up: when we heavy-customize prompts prefill misfires sometimes; warm-pool helped.

Marcus (SRE): Heuristic: if system_prompt_tokens > 180 or variable_count > 4 mark tenant high-personalization and allocate warm-pool (8m).

Ruth (Eng): We'll add prefill.hit_count and prefill.miss_count metrics (tags: tenant, region, sanitized) and a Console tile for hit_ratio.

Ivy (CS): Draft CS checklist for modal: 
- Toggle "Demo quickshot" 2-3m prior
- Pin model_variant
- Check prefill.hit_ratio > 65%
- If personalization flagged -> enable warm-pool
- If hit_ratio < 40% -> fallback to streaming-only and ping #customer-success-escalations

ops-bot: Alert rule configured: prefill failures >3 in 10m -> #eng-oncall then #customer-success-escalations.

Theo (Solutions): Post-demo: send 1-question pulse (Snappy? Y/N) and auto-attach prefill.trace to enablement ticket for quicker triage.

Ivy (CS): I'll add the checklist to the modal and run with 8 more accounts this week. Thanks y'all!
